title: verify/x_sig: extract_sig_header builds format string on every line
description: crates/verify/src/x_sig.rs extract_sig_header() line 134 — format\!("{SIG_HEADER}:") allocates a new String for the prefix 'X-Stoa-Sig:' on every call to extract_sig_header. This prefix is constant; it should be a const &str so the allocation is eliminated. The resulting prefix check on line 161 can use a const comparison.
